name: polish
description: Replaces vague 'looks good' UI feedback with a fixed, repeatable audit: walks a design system, UI, or app screen against 14 categories of proven UI/UX practice — iconography, color, typography, hierarchy, spacing, states, shadows, dark mode, overlays, page patterns, and accessibility — and returns a severity- and effort-scored findings report with a concrete fix for each issue. Specifically flags AI/vibe-coded tells (emoji icons, clashing default palettes, duplicated modules, dead cards, missing focus indicators) since they're high-value, low-effort fixes.
